scenes.stage_direction: The conversation moves between Amara's home and the estate's public offices. Keep documents distinct from what people claim about them.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: His acknowledgement is here. So is the private bequest.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: He held Ethan while he signed. I remember being afraid the pen would stain his sleeve.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: But this copy is missing the page that supports it.

metadata.evidence_summary: Adrian acknowledged Ethan and made him a private provision.
